primary_claim: Using SAE attribution to find features important for a proxy 'list-ending' metric in Gemma 2, then zero-ablating the top-5 (position, feature) pairs, can fully suppress the model's list-ending behavior for some SAEs (most strongly for a residual-stream layer-0 SAE), though effectiveness varies substantially across layers and components, and simpler alternative techniques (restricted sampling, steering vectors) can achieve similar suppression more easily.

effect.metric: average change in number of list items generated, ablated vs. base generation, per SAE/layer
effect.value: residual-stream layer-0 SAE ablation produces the largest reduction (mean items diff about 22.2, close to the 'short list' template length); attention-layer SAEs show much smaller effects (mean items diff roughly 0.7 to 3.3)

contradicts_or_qualifies: Notes that while ablating key SAE features can suppress list-ending behavior, mechanistic interpretability techniques do not outperform simpler alternatives such as restricted sampling or steering vectors, which the author frames as a common pattern where MI 'usually gets the short end of the stick' when benchmarked against alternative techniques
stated_future_work: Benchmark different heuristics for selecting layers based on memory cost versus circuit faithfulness
Apply established feature-explanation techniques to the relevant dataset
Use transcoders and hierarchical attribution to develop complete linear circuits
limitations_stated: Zero ablations in attention head outputs suppressed list-ending behavior but put the model out of distribution, producing generations with repetitions and cycles
The investigation falls short of the broader goals of mechanistic interpretability despite some progress
Full elimination of list-ending behavior with just 5 edits is encouraging, but results are not fully satisfactory
SAEs producing less than 1 extra item on average were classified as not effective at suppressing the list-ending behavior
quote: While the empiric results are encouraging, (full elimination of the list ending behavior with just 5 edits), the results are not fully satisfactory.
